description: Stores a photo for staff feedback or a coaching review, as Add photo does, and returns its url (a stable serve-on-read link) and path. Put the url in a tier2 item's photos through save_coaching_review or edit_coaching_review. Send the picture bytes as content_base64 with its file_name; a JPEG, PNG, GIF or WebP, 5 MB at most. Client-home interior photos stay private. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying; a repeat returns the image the first call stored.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: upload_staff_feedback_image
title: Upload a photo for staff feedback or a coaching review
